# CG-REQ-020: Request enum value removed

A request value is restricted to fewer enumerated values.

**Why it matters:** Requests using a removed value become invalid.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.enumChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} no longer accepts {values}.
>
> Consumers sending a removed value will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep accepting the removed values, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: enum value removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b, c]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. POST /x: the request body (application/json) no longer accepts c.

### Fires: const changed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, const: x}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, const: y}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. POST /x: the request body (application/json) no longer accepts x.

### Does not fire: values reordered

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [b, a]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: value added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b, c]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Whether consumers actually send the removed values is unknown.

```yaml

  ignore:

      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
```
